description: This file is a Perl module implementing migration procedures for svn repositories within a Git context. It contains functions to migrate from different repository layouts and to optimize remote connections, indicating it handles repository layout transformations and related logic.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 0 layout to newer, updating references and renaming branches accordingly.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Handles migration from version 1 layout which involves copying info files and updating references for git-svn repositories.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository layout by reading old URLs and initializing SVN remotes accordingly.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by consolidating remotes and updating configuration to reduce redundant connections.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Executes all migration functions and optimization steps based on configuration.
